# AI-skills

fdshg693/AI の Claude Code 用スキル（tools に依存しない汎用プラグイン群）。マーケットプレイス定義はアンブレラ（fdshg693/AI）の .claude-plugin/marketplace.json にあり、各プラグインはこのリポジトリの plugins/<name> を指す。

このリポジトリは [fdshg693/AI](https://github.com/fdshg693/AI) のサブモジュール（`skills/`）です。生成・検査・ワークスペース（uv / pnpm）はアンブレラ側にあるため、アンブレラから clone して使います。

```sh
git clone --recurse-submodules https://github.com/fdshg693/AI.git
```

## プラグイン一覧

- [ai-tools-knowledge](plugins/ai-tools-knowledge/): Knowledge skills about other AI coding tools \(Codex, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Antigravity, Cline, Kilo Code\): docs, CLIs, SDKs, memory, skills and plugins
- [cc-knowledge](plugins/cc-knowledge/): Skills about Claude Code itself: docs, settings, and how to write skills, hooks, plugins and subagents
- [cicd](plugins/cicd/): Skills for GitHub Actions diagnosis, agentic workflows, issue triage and PR-Agent
- [coding](plugins/coding/): Skills for brainstorming, debugging, code review, pull requests and development workflows
- [doc-tools](plugins/doc-tools/): Document processing skills that bundle their own scripts \(no tools/ install needed\)
- [no-code](plugins/no-code/): Skills for non-coding tasks, including French language learning
- [others](plugins/others/): Skills for GitHub content retrieval and VS Code documentation
- [special](plugins/special/): Skills for grouping and managing Claude Code skills and commands
- [subagents](plugins/subagents/): Skills for parallel agent dispatch, subagent-driven development and test-driven development
- [topics](plugins/topics/): Topic-specific documentation skills for AI services, developer tools and Mermaid diagrams
- [web-lookup](plugins/web-lookup/): Web research skills that bundle their own scripts \(no tools/ install needed\)
